title: Dwell band: everyone waiting now, judged by team cadence, linked to the board
deviations_from_card: Case 7 built as the critic restated it: cadenceEditable(stage, axis) (terminal and off-axis columns false) plus a pure save plan app/features/insights/analytics/stageCadenceSavePlan.ts (+ test), which maps DECISION_CONFIG_INVALID to the band's own bounds sentence and every other code (FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY, DECISION_CONFIG_SAVE_FAILED) through the errors catalog. PIPELINE_AXIS_STALE dropped. pastCadence counts tier !== 'none' (aging + stalled) through aging-policy agingTier on whole days (daysInStageAt), so it equals the board's ?quick=aging set. Added outside the declared write set: stageCadenceSavePlan.ts/.test.ts (the critic's revision asks for it), PerformanceBriefing.tsx (one line, onCadenceSaved={reload}, the panel's only caller) and perf-budget.json under the lock. cadenceEditable is computed server-side into each row (the client has no axis), from the pure function in stageDwellGate.ts. The acceptance fixture for team cadence uses applyStageSla + setDecisionConfig (the route's own pure half and store) rather than driving the PATCH handler. 8 of 8 card cases covered by 18 node:test cases.
notes: Commit order: catalogs (lock) -> doc (lock) -> perf budget (lock) -> code+tests. Perf: measured in a scratch worktree at 8bcc663d9 with only this card's files swapped in: app/page.tsx 1407/8860 KB -> 1410/8874 KB (+3 modules: stageCadenceSavePlan.ts, AnalyticsStageCadenceInput.tsx, analytics-bottleneck.ts), raised maxModules 1407 -> 1410 in d2c578d06; analytics routes +3 modules/+20 KB, far under ceilings. The other perf findings on the shared checkout (page.tsx 1412/8906, analyze/redraft/devcase/intake/jds/status-letter/tasks-retry route KB) are sibling commits/uncommitted files, not in the card-alone measurement. tsc exit 2: before my repair only DevEvalPanelScores.tsx (devcase sibling) + the untracked kpi-sim/ tree; zero errors on my paths. INCIDENT, coordinator must know: removing my perf worktree (node_modules junctioned) failed on 'Filename too long' AFTER git had traversed the junction and deleted node_modules/.bin and every top-level @scope sorting before @sentry (@babel, @eslint, @next, @playwright, @axe-core, @google, @elevenlabs, ...). Repaired immediately with `npm install --no-audit --no-fund` (package-lock.json rewrite reverted with git checkout; npm ls --depth=0 now clean). That install also brought 8 previously stale packages up to the lockfile (next-intl 4.13 -> 4.14.5, framer-motion, autoprefixer, postcss, @sentry/*), so node_modules now equals what CI's npm ci installs - and with it tsc reports 4 new TS7006 errors in instrumentation.ts / instrumentation-client.ts (Sentry beforeSend/beforeBreadcrumb params implicit any under @sentry/nextjs 10.71.0 + top-level @sentry/core 10.69.0 from the lockfile). Those are latent in the committed lockfile, not in this card; siblings running tsc will now see them. Do not junction node_modules into a worktree you then `git worktree remove` - delete the junction first. Full test:unit after repair: only python-runner-concurrency BROKEN (foreign, process-tree kill); every analytics test green (264 across the touched dirs).
